digest.component_or_area: BindingStore module and binding lifecycle management
propositions: BindingStore (799 LOC) couples byte persistence, lifecycle policy, recovery, and peer-state delegation with no cohesive ownership; production code mutates inner entries via shallow all_bindings() query without mutation guards

Retirement completion must enforce journal-free durable tombstone semantics: a live forward/reverse pair is removed only when tombstone, forward, and reverse identities all agree; only explicit unretire revokes intent

Three internal owners (repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, recovery) must be extracted behind a preserved public facade with unchanged import signatures, serialization format, unknown-field preservation, and shallow all_bindings() behavior
Live recovery must run after staleness validation but before remote issue observation to prevent upgraded passes from interleaving new liveness evidence with completion
Automatic liveness signals (absent_404_count, clear_absent, confirm) cannot override durable retirement intent; only explicit unretire removes the tombstone and prevents completion
